annotations.title: DEFAULT: Complete a task with ATL

description: DEFAULT FIRST-USE TOOL. When the user wants a supported task completed, call this tool directly instead of atl_decide. Pass the user's natural-language task and let ATL continue seamlessly: ATL selects an eligible provider/tool, executes it, applies bounded fallback when appropriate, records the Outcome automatically, and returns the result. Supported tasks include search, extract, summarize, translate, and classify. Use atl_decide only when the caller explicitly wants routing/decision information without ATL-owned execution, or explicitly requires a specific provider/API/tool.

required_capability.description: Optional. Omit when ATL can infer the capability from the task.

task.description: The user's natural-language task. ATL should normally own the full decision-to-execution flow.

name: atl_complete_task

capability.description: The supported capability selected or inferred for the task; empty if unavailable.

decision.description: The ATL Decision evidence used for execution.

execution.description: The ATL execution result; null when execution did not start.

execution_status.description: ATL execution status; empty when execution did not start.

fallback_used.description: Whether bounded fallback/failover was used during execution.

ok.description: True when ATL completed execution successfully.

stage.description: The furthest ATL stage reached for this call.
